findings.section: Design S2 step 6 (content screen) / S6 planted-secret control
findings.note: The coverage assertion counts paths the packager submits, not paths detect-secrets confirms it scanned, and the plan does not specify how findings are detected (detect-secrets scan exits 0 even with findings; the emitted baseline JSON must be parsed). The planted-secret positive control makes a vacuous or misparsed gate fail, so deferral is acceptable - but tasks should explicitly pin the output-parsing contract (parse results from the baseline JSON, not rely on exit code).

The capture timestamp makes SNAPSHOT.json nondeterministic across reruns of the same tree; harmless given the stated contract (each assembly is a distinct named snapshot), but worth a one-line statement in the README/contract that identical trees yield different inventory bytes, so inventory-digest comparison is per-snapshot, not per-tree. No plan change required.
